description:
How much of a suburb or city block sits inside the published aircraft-noise zones around Australian airports: share of addresses in each noise band, the loudest band, and whether the airport has a night curfew.

Coverage: About 250 suburbs and 4,700 blocks have at least one address inside a published zone (NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, NT); about 1,700 more suburbs and 110,000 blocks within 20 km of such an airport are listed at 0%. Everywhere else, and Brisbane, Hobart and Canberra, is not listed. Current to 2026-10-19. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/aircraft-noise`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: addresses_total, addresses_in_zone, in_zone_share_pct, band_15_20_pct, band_20_25_pct, band_25_30_pct, band_30_plus_pct, highest_anef_band, curfew_airport_share_pct, approx_zone_share_pct. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_environment_aircraft_noise
title: Suburb · Aircraft noise zones
